description: Commercial-register publications from the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce in a date range.

cantons.description: Canton codes to keep; filtering runs client-side.

event_types.description: Event types to keep; each listed publication's body is fetched and only rows whose events intersect are kept.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 100; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

query.description: Title text to match, in any language.

since.description: Start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to yesterday; ranges wider than 7 days are trimmed to the newest 7 days.

sub_rubrics.description: Sub-rubrics to keep, e.g. HR01 (registrations), HR02 (mutations), HR03 (deletions).

until.description: End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: swissco_publications
